note: Per-lane exemptions from the n8n dispatch forbidden-token rule. Only tokens in lane_dispatch.EXEMPTIBLE_TOKENS (the market_day_gate.sh calendar gate) may ever be listed; an entry naming any other token is dropped whole (fail closed), and a missing or malformed file means no exceptions. An exemption removes only the eligibility block for the listed token (and the matching B1 stay_on_cron pipeline_excluded_gate marker); every other forbidden token, stay-behind and sender rule still applies, and dispatch mode stays off until a registry dispatch block says otherwise.
